Code reviews have evolved from line-by-line inspections to AI-assisted outcome validation. In this video, we explore how software reviews have progressed from Fagan inspections and pair programming to pull requests, CI/CD automation, and AI-powered development workflows. Learn why the future of code reviews is shifting away from implementation details and toward validating intent, requirements, outcomes, and business impact.
